body:
[A158] MEASUREMENT / AUTHOR HANDOFF

Committed author head: `0d43ff25d38917e77bb5c3d2ddb6473013cea3ba`, branch `440-markdown-closers`, base `b17580b91deb11f3441dfc5d7f9fafe539d929b8`. No push or PR action.

The settled closing rules are implemented: fence trailers use the named space/tab class; any of the four literal type-1 closing names ends any type-1 block, on either the opening or a later line, ASCII-folded and without inner blanks. Global refusal, folding, precedence, paragraph/container state and the provenance basis remain unchanged. #437 remains separate. `I440` is the new control family; existing cases and quality budgets are retained. A separate fixture module avoids crossing the existing long-module limit.

The historical instrument was not obtainable from the linked public reports or reviewed tree. I reconstructed their documented character population, including the 25 non-CR fence rows, 27 non-CR type-1 rows, CR, valid controls, Unicode folds and all cross-name pairs. Identical 205-fixture sweeps ran on base/head against GitHub gfm, with synthetic input only.

| Measurement | Agree | Escape | Withhold |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Base raw helpers | 90 | 62 | 53 |
| Head raw helpers | 200 | 0 | 5 |
| Base after shipped-reader normalization | 93 | 60 | 52 |
| Head after shipped-reader normalization | 205 | 0 | 0 |

Escape lists a heading the renderer hides; withhold omits a rendered heading. The five raw residues all carry CR (`F-backtick-U000D`, `F-tilde-U000D`, `B-fence-crlf`, `B-fence-cr`, `B-type1-cr`), belong to the unchanged refusal family, and disappear after the actual readers normalize CR/CRLF. The normalized helper comparison includes 100 rows the global policy still refuses; it does not claim those as accepted pages. Existing ASCII folding already closes the historical Unicode-name cases at this base; all eight measured rows remain unchanged.

The shipped em-dash CLI and per-page path were also compared at base/head. Four inner-blank label escapes change from findings/exempt `0/1` to `1/0`; two legitimate cross-name controls change `1/0` to `0/1`. Refusal and Unicode controls stay held. A CR-only fence exempts its legitimate label but Git's LF-delimited diff additionally judges the heading as added; the receipt distinguishes that from normalization. Eighteen extra GitHub HTML receipts cover these exact base/head pages.

All 163 tracked pages retain their headings and generated Contents; both engines give identical classifications on both populations, with 105 provenance-bearing pages. No tracked parser correction is needed. The only Markdown content edit is the closing-rule explanation in `docs/DOC_GENERATION.md`.

Focused results: TOC 683/683; em-dash 51/51 and actual-base gate 0 findings over 32 added lines; TOC check 105 pages; 144 fragment links reproduced; docs_check, doc paths, style, hygiene, Python ratchets/selftest, class/source guards pass. All eleven mutations fail behavioral I440 arms, including retained Unicode controls. Fence widening is intentionally masked by the shipped refusal, and its raw controls fail independently. Tracked files and initialized submodules are clean.

Exact fixtures, HTML receipts, every row, portable instruments and mutation evidence are public in [receipt part 1](https://github.com/kebag-logic/milan-fpga/issues/440#issuecomment-5771717445) and [part 2](https://github.com/kebag-logic/milan-fpga/issues/440#issuecomment-5771717582). Concatenate their base64 fences and decompress gzip to recover the JSON files; SHA-256 is `4f826e84ed800957e26966002319d69766d7f5ce563a6966eb05b1f8a2addd20`.

A10 still owns complete native RTL/processor/builder/Yosys/behave gates, trusted act, hosted CI, publication, independent R225/R226 review, candidate validation and merge. None of those checks or actions was run by this isolated author. No full milan_dp sweep, Docker, installation, privilege, hardware, unrelated lane edit or subagent action occurred.
